title: A context manager for mini-dsh
brief: Give mini-dsh the context layer that keeps a long session useful. You build a system prompt service that sorts plugin sections, two pre-step listeners (a time note and AGENTS.md), a token meter with the dsh threshold formula, a safe cut, a surface replacement that leaves the record untouched, and recovery from a too-large request. Every test runs without a real model: a scripted callModel returns fixed summaries and, when asked, a CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED error. When you finish, a session can run for hours: old messages turn into one summary in the model's view, and the record still holds every fact.

starter.note: SystemPrompt with section() and render(): sort by order, then by name; drop empty text; join with a blank line.
agent/pre-step listener that adds a time-context user message at most every 600,000 ms.
Reads AGENTS.md at turn 1, step 1; a tools/result listener records touched paths; the next pre-step adds an updated note when the text changed.
estimateMessage() (4 characters per token, 4 per block, 4 per role), measure(), thresholdTokens(W, reply, headroom).
selectRange(), compactRange() with compaction/start, compaction/summary, a replacing user/message and compaction/end, and the agent/request-error listener.
append() learns surfaceOp 'append' or { op: 'replace', startSeq, endSeq }, and keeps surface and replaceCount.
Scripted callModel and a fixed clock; one test per milestone.

hints: Sort with a.order - b.order first and compare names only on a tie, so the start order of plugins never changes the bytes.
Use a fake clock in tests: pass now() into the time listener instead of calling Date.now() inside it.
Check your threshold with W = 10,000, reply = 1,000, headroom = 2,000: the answer is 7,000, and the amount to keep is 1,440.
balancedBefore() only needs a set of open call ids: add on tool_use, delete on tool_result, and the cut is safe when the set is empty.
Build the derived history from session.surface, never from the whole log, or the summary will appear beside the messages it replaced.

rubric.criterion: Sections render in order and name order, empty sections leave no blank lines, and a disposer removes a section.
The time note is a logged user message at the end of the history and respects the 10-minute interval.
AGENTS.md is added at the first step and again only after a successful tool changed its text.
The meter starts from reported usage and the threshold is floor(min(W * 0.8, W - reply - headroom)).
The selected range never includes the system prompt and never separates a tool call from its result.
A summary replaces the range in the surface while every earlier record event stays unchanged, bracketed by start and end events.
A CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED error leads to at most one retry, and only after replaceCount rose.

milestones.title: Sorted prompt sections
milestones.body: Register read (1100), identity (-1000) and bash (1000) in that order and check render() returns identity, bash, read. Dispose bash and check it is gone.

milestones.title: Time note and AGENTS.md
milestones.body: With a fake clock at 09:00:00, 09:00:05 and 09:12:00, check two time notes. Edit AGENTS.md through the edit tool and check one updated note at the next step.

milestones.title: Meter and threshold
milestones.body: Check thresholdTokens(10000, 1000, 2000) is 7000, and that 5,200 reported plus a 6,000-character result measures 6,708.

milestones.title: Safe cut and replacement
milestones.body: Use the eight messages from the lesson: the range is messages 1 to 3, and after compactRange() the surface is [0, 10, 4, 5, 6, 7] with 12 events in the log.

milestones.title: Overflow recovery
milestones.body: Script one CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED error: the step retries once and succeeds. Script two in a row: the turn ends with the error after one retry.
